title: 练习一（2025年）

41.why: “都要和周围的人发生……关系” explains why nobody exists in isolation.

options.label: A
options.zh: 不依赖别人，独立生活或做事
options.note: Self-reliance is different from having no connection with others.

options.label: B
options.zh: 与周围的人或事物缺少联系
options.note: Use: 孤立存在. The next clause says everyone has relationships.

options.label: C
options.zh: 与其他陆地分离的岛；也可比喻孤立的事物
options.note: A noun. “不是孤岛存在的” does not fit this sentence structure.

options.label: D
options.zh: 与众不同，有自己的特点
options.note: Having relationships does not mean a person cannot be unique.

42.why: 合作 means working together. 互相配合 directly explains how people “共同把事情做好”.

options.label: A
options.zh: 不同事物结合成一个整体
options.note: Use: 文化融合. Cooperation does not require people to merge into one.

options.label: B
options.zh: 按一定标准安排或分发
options.note: Use: 分配任务. One possible step, not the meaning of cooperation.

options.label: C
options.zh: 共同出资经营
options.note: A business arrangement; narrower than cooperation in general.

options.label: D
options.zh: 互相协调，协助完成任务
options.note: Use: 互相配合. Matches doing something well together.

43.why: A key opens a door. The passage compares cooperation skills to a key to success.

options.label: A
options.zh: 开锁的工具；也可比喻解决问题的关键
options.note: Matches “打开成功之门”.

options.label: B
options.zh: 不让人知道的事情
options.note: A secret does not fit the door-and-lock image as directly.

options.label: C
options.zh: 特别有效的办法；原指有神奇力量的宝物
options.note: Can mean a useful method, but it does not complete the door metaphor.

options.label: D
options.zh: 储藏宝贵东西的地方
options.note: It is a place, not the tool used to open a door.

44.why: 有成效地合作 means cooperating in a way that produces useful results.

options.label: A
options.zh: 工作或学习等取得的成果
options.note: Use: 取得成绩. Not the natural phrase “有成绩地合作”.

options.label: B
options.zh: 事物达到的水平
options.note: Use: 程度较高. Does not mean effective cooperation.

options.label: C
options.zh: 某种原因产生的作用或反应
options.note: An effect may be neutral or negative; it is not the usual phrase here.

options.label: D
options.zh: 工作等产生的实际效果
options.note: Use: 有成效的合作、有成效地工作.

45.why: The orchestra is a representative example of successful cooperation. 典范 fits a practice that others can learn from.

options.label: A
options.zh: 行为等应遵守的标准或规则
options.note: Rules for cooperation are not the same as an example of it.

options.label: B
options.zh: 值得学习、具有代表性的好例子
options.note: Use: 合作的典范. The performance demonstrates the idea.

options.label: C
options.zh: 值得学习的人或事例
options.note: Close in meaning; 典范 is more natural here for an exemplary form of cooperation. 榜样 is not restricted to people.

options.label: D
options.zh: 制作或操作时参照的固定样式
options.note: A reusable pattern, not a judgement that the performance is exemplary.

46.why: The sentence describes pleasant musical sound, so 悠扬 is the most suitable word.

options.label: A
options.zh: 时间长或声音绵长
options.note: Emphasises length or duration, not mainly the pleasing quality of music.

options.label: B
options.zh: 年代长远
options.note: Use: 历史悠久. Describes history or time.

options.label: C
options.zh: 声音高低起伏，和谐悦耳而传得远
options.note: Use: 悠扬的乐曲.

options.label: D
options.zh: 距离遥远或时间久远
options.note: Focuses on distance or remoteness, not the musical quality here.

47.why: Many musicians and instruments work together smoothly. 完美和谐 describes that coordinated result.

options.label: A
options.zh: 没有畏惧
options.note: About courage, not how instruments work together.

options.label: B
options.zh: 配合协调，相处融洽
options.note: Use: 完美和谐. Matches the orchestra's coordinated performance.

options.label: C
options.zh: 把几个部分合在一起；合成的整体
options.note: The sentence needs a quality of cooperation, not the act of combining.

options.label: D
options.zh: 最高的境界或程度
options.note: Use: 达到极致. “完美极致” does not fit this construction as naturally.

48.why: The successful three-second rescue impresses the audience, and they cannot help clapping.

options.label: A
options.zh: 纷纷到来，连续不断
options.note: Describes arrival, not clapping.

options.label: B
options.zh: 不偏向任何一方；也指正好在中间
options.note: Neither fairness nor position explains the applause.

options.label: C
options.zh: 抓住时机，立即作出决定
options.note: The audience is reacting emotionally, not making an urgent decision.

options.label: D
options.zh: 感情激动，控制不住自己
options.note: Use: 情不自禁地鼓掌.

49.why: “心中想着别人……集体” points to putting collective needs before one's own interests.

options.label: A
options.zh: 努力争取达到或得到
options.note: Focuses on what someone wants to achieve, not giving up personal interests.

options.label: B
options.zh: 放弃，不再保留
options.note: Use: 舍弃某物. “自我牺牲” is the natural expression for the spirit described here.

options.label: C
options.zh: 为他人或某个目的放弃自身利益；也可指献出生命
options.note: Here 自我牺牲 means putting the group first; it does not mean losing one's life.

options.label: D
options.zh: 选择保留什么、放弃什么
options.en: choose what to keep or give up
options.note: A decision process, not necessarily concern for others.

50.why: The passage contrasts competition with the need for cooperation in modern society.

options.label: A
options.zh: 为了同一目标而相互争取胜出
options.note: Use: 充满竞争的社会. It forms the contrast with “合作”.

options.label: B
options.zh: 认真计较，追究细节或真假
options.en: take things seriously; insist on details
options.note: Describes an attitude, not the social relationship intended here.

options.label: C
options.zh: 互相比试、较量
options.note: Often describes a particular contest or comparison; 竞争 is broader and more natural here.

options.label: D
options.zh: 对立、抵抗或相互斗争
options.note: Stronger hostility than general social competition.

paragraphs: 任何人在这个世界上都不是{41}存在的，都要和周围的人发生各种各样的关系。
合作就是互相{42}，共同把事情做好。一个人学会了与别人合作，也就获得了打开成功之门的{43}。
怎样才能有{44}地合作呢？你一定在音乐厅或电视里看到过交响乐团的演奏吧。这可算得上是人与人合作的{45}了。你瞧，指挥家轻轻一扬手里的指挥棒，{46}的乐曲便从乐师的嘴唇边、指缝里演奏出来。是什么力量使上百位乐师，数十种不同的乐器合作得这样完美{47}？我想，这主要依靠高度统一的团体目标和每个人所发挥的协作精神。

还有一个小故事，也能说明这个道理。几个小学生做了一个小实验。一个小口瓶里，放着七个穿线的彩球，线的一端露出瓶子。这个瓶子代表一个房间，彩球代表被困在房间里的人，哨声响起代表“房子着火”。听到哨声，七个孩子一个接着一个，依次从瓶子里取出了自己的彩球，拯救“被困的人”。整个过程总共才用了3秒钟！在场的人{48}地鼓起掌来。可见成功的合作不仅要有统一的目标，要尽力做好份内的事情，而且还要心中想着别人，心中想着集体，有自我{49}的精神。
现代社会是一个充满{50}的社会，但同时也是一个更加需要合作的社会。作为一个现代人，只有学会与别人合作，才能取得更大的成功。
